Physical_Definition: Solid ice column thickness at pure ice density rho_i = 917 kg m^-3
Spatial_Domain: 1D Flowline Grid Cell Centers (x in [0, x_GL])
Initial_Condition_Source: BedMachine Antarctica V4.1 (500 m raster sampled along flowline)
Physical_Bounds: H >= 0.0 m (strictly non-negative via flux limiting)
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Flux-limited truncation at H=0; negative thickness prohibited and asserted in solver

Physical_Definition: Equivalent pore space air column depth in upper firn layer
Initial_Condition_Source: IMAU-FDM (Ligtenberg et al. 2011; Kuipers Munneke et al. 2014)
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Capped at 0.0 m when firn is fully saturated / melted

Physical_Definition: Total geometric thickness of combined ice and firn column: H + FAC
Initial_Condition_Source: BedMachine V4.1 ice thickness + IMAU-FDM FAC
Physical_Bounds: H_geom >= H (always greater than or equal to solid ice thickness)
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Evaluated directly from prognostic H and dynamic FAC

Physical_Definition: True upper ice/firn surface elevation relative to geoid: z_b + H_geom
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Enforces s = z_b when ice-free (H = 0, FAC = 0)

Physical_Definition: Bedrock elevation relative to sea level (geoid)
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Fixed in time; no subglacial erosion on century timescales

Physical_Definition: Depth-averaged horizontal flow velocity along flowline
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Velocity clamped to 0.0 at divide; non-negative directed outflow

Physical_Definition: Continuous curvilinear distance from ice divide to grounding line interface
Evolution_Equation_or_Diagnostic: Prognostic Root Tracking (Flotation Condition Delta z_flot = 0)
Initial_Condition_Source: MEaSUREs / BedMachine V4.1 Grounding Line Mask
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Continuous sub-grid bracket interpolation prevents grid node pinning

Physical_Definition: Solid ice-equivalent thickness at instantaneous grounding line x_GL
Initial_Condition_Source: Evaluated from BedMachine V4.1 bed at x_GL
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Strictly tied to hydrostatic flotation condition

Physical_Definition: Dimensionless parameter scaling embayment backstress: 1=steady state, 0=lost
Spatial_Domain: Ice Shelf Embayment Seaward of Grounding Line
Evolution_Equation_or_Diagnostic: Dynamic State Variable / Parameterized Scenario Indicator
Initial_Condition_Source: Phase 3.2 Reconstruction (1.0 steady state; 0.0 post-collapse in Larsen B)

Physical_Definition: Integrated solid ice-equivalent volume across entire grounded basin
Evolution_Equation_or_Diagnostic: Prognostic (Mass Conservation Integral dV/dt = SMB - D_GL - M_unground)

Physical_Definition: Sum of three basin grounded solid ice-equivalent volumes
Evolution_Equation_or_Diagnostic: Diagnostic Linear Sum (V_Domain_A = V_HpI + V_IIpp + V_IppJ)
Invalid_Cell_Handling: Zero independent regional uncoupled drift permitted
